node: Tariff, customs, domestic-content, and supply-chain compliance infrastructure
summary: Layer 1B expands the public universe around compliance infrastructure rather than tariff-protected manufacturers. The strongest direct software/data candidate found is Descartes Systems, whose disclosures explicitly include customs/regulatory compliance, global trade intelligence, denied-party screening, duty minimization, sourcing analysis, and trade-content workflows. A second lane is testing/inspection/certification and market-access infrastructure, where UL Solutions and MISTRAS are less obvious beneficiaries of product documentation, regulatory approvals, and aerospace/defense compliance gates. Expeditors is included as a reference/context anchor for customs brokerage demand and tariff-driven compliance workload, but it is larger and more obvious than the preferred underfollowed lane.
